quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: Studsvik, GE Vernova Hitachi and Samsung C&T commit to (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Development agreement, not an order: after a competitive evaluation, Studsvik selected GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy (GVH, the GE Vernova-Hitachi joint venture) and Samsung C&T as strategic collaborators for its ReFirm program - an initial four-unit BWRX-300 project of approximately 1,200 MWe (1.2 GW) at Nyköping or Valdemarsvik, Sweden, with the first unit expected to enter operation in the mid-2030s. The agreement is exclusive for a fixed period and is not a final investment decision or authorization to construct. GVH leads reactor engineering, licensing support and cost estimation and, with Samsung C&T, acts as the execution team; GE Vernova's Financial Services business participates in an advisory and financial structuring capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: four BWRX-300 units, approximately 1,200 MWe (1.2 GW); first unit mid-2030s
